male solo a parlarne{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.

{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ich werde nie seekrank!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Das Schau-

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Voyaging by boat is fun!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} The sea
breeze takes all your cares away
and turns them to sea salt!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}If something bad ever happens to
you,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} hop on a boat and take to the
high seas!
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Well,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} unless your troubles all have to
do with being stranded out at sea{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Navegar es muy divertido!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
La brisa marina se lleva tus
penas y las convierte en sal.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}¡Si estás deprimido,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} no hay
mejor cura que subirte a un
barco y echarte a la mar!
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}A no ser que lo hayas perdido,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
como es mi caso{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Les voyages en bateau, c'est génial !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
La brise marine emporte tous les
soucis et les change en fleur de sel !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Si tu as des problèmes,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} embarque
sur un navire et pars explorer la
grande bleue !
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Enfin,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} fais quand même attention à
pas te retrouver {{TAG:000E:0006:10006E00610075006600720061006700E90012006E00610075006600720061006700E9006500}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Viaggiare via mare è divertente!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
La brezza marina fa sparire
tutte le preoccupazioni!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Se ti capita di avere dei brutti
pensieri,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} prendi una barca
e vai ad esplorare il mare!
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Certo,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} se le tue preoccupazioni
sono legate al fatto che sei appena
naufragato, forse non funziona{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Eine Seefahrt, die ist lustig!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Und vor allem lässt sie vergessen!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Wenn du irgendwann mal vor lauter
Sorgen nicht weiterweißt, stich
einfach in See!
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Nun ja, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}außer deine Sorgen
stammen alle daher, dass
du gestrandet bist{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Tekneyle yolculuk{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} harikadır!
Deniz meltemi bütün dertleri
alır, tuza çevirip{{TAG:0003:0015:}} götürür.
Başına kötü bir şey{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} gelirse bir
tekneye atla, açık{{TAG:0003:000C:}} denize{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} çık!
Tabii derdin denizde mahsur
kalmaksa... o başka{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}The sea is fantastic!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} If you're sad or
worried,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} the sea will wrap you in her
arms like you're a baby in a blanket!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}She's just like my mom back home!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000A:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}It's been a long time since I've had
her spaghetti and wormballs...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Ah, il mare...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Quando sei triste,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
il mare ti accoglie tra le sue
braccia come un bambino!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}È come la mia mamma!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000A:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ora che ci penso è una vita
che non mangio i suoi vermicelli
con sugo di pesce fresco...
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Das Meer ist wie eine liebende
Mutter!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Bist du traurig, nimmt es
dich zärtlich in die Arme!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Genau wie zu Hause meine Mama!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000A:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ach je, ist das lange her, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}dass ich
ihre hausgemachten Regenwurm-
Spaghetti gekostet habe!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Deniz muhteşem!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Üzgün ya da
kaygılıysan{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} seni battaniyeye
sarılmış bebek gibi kucaklar.
Tıpkı{{TAG:0003:0001:}} evdeki annem gibi! ..{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000A:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.Onun{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
spagettiyle solucan köftesini
yemeyeli çok oldu...

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}The boat I was riding on is way
different from Mr. {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Kapp'n{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}'s!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}It has the latest doodads and super-
deluxe thingamabobbers!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Still wasn't enough to keep me
from going overboard, though.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Mi barco, el Percebe Intrépido II,
es el mejor navío que flota por
estas aguas.
Nada que ver con el bote del viejo
{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Capitán{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Me han dicho que ahora
se dedica al turismo. {{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Será verdad?
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡El caso es que mi barco está
equipado para superar cualquier
contratiempo!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Salvo que el capitán se caiga
por la borda...
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Le navire à bord duquel je
voyageais n'avait rien à voir avec 
celui de monsieur {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Amiral {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
C'était un bateau dernier cri ultra-
perfectionné avec airbag, direction
assistée et verrouillage centralisé !
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Enfin, ça ne m'a pas empêché de
passer par-dessus bord...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}La barca sulla quale stavo
navigando è molto diversa
da quella del signor {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Remo{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
Ha tutti gli ammennicoli di nuova
generazione e tanti gingilli all'ultimo
grido!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Certo, non sono bastati a impedire
che finissi in mare...
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Mein Schiff ist mit {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Käptens
{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}Seelenverkäufer nicht zu
vergleichen!
Radar, Funktelefon, Autopilot,
Kälteschlafkammer...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Das Ding
ist mit High-Tech vollgestopft!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Nur leider nichts, was verhindert,
dass man über Bord gehen kann...
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Benim bindiğim gemi
Kapp'n'ınkinden çok{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}} farklı!{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}} Son
model zımbırtılar, süper lüks
şeyler... Ne ararsan{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} var! Yine
de denize düşmemi engelleyemediler.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}This outfit I'm wearing is the very
symbol of a sailor!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Plus it makes
me look incredibly charming!
{{TAG:0003:002C:}}Charm{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} activated!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}I mean,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} if I wore some other outfit,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
it'd just look silly to find me lying
here on the beach.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Can you imagine the look on your
face if I were dressed as a cowboy?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Ooh,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} that's not a bad idea{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Cuando me has visto vestido así,
enseguida te has dado cuenta de
que era un marinero, ¿no?
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Si me vieras con otro traje,
aquí tirado en la playa, creerías
que estoy loco.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}¿Y si me hubieses encontrado
vestido de vaquero? ¿Te imaginas?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Pues no es mala idea{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}L'uniforme que je porte est le
symbole de tous les marins ! En plus
il sied tout à fait à mon teint !
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Et puis j'aurais l'air ridicule si
j'étais échoué sur cette plage dans
un autre accoutrement.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Imagine la tête que tu ferais si
j'étais habillé en cowboy !{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Quoique,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} c'est une idée à creuser{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Il mio abbigliamento è quello
tradizionale da marinaio. E poi,
mi dà un'aria da vero elegantone!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Voglio dire, se fossi vestito
diversamente, sarei davvero
strano qui in spiaggia, no?
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Ti immagini che faccia avresti
fatto se mi avessi trovato qui
vestito da cowboy?
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Ehi,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ma sarebbe stato
divertentissimo!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Dieses Outfit ist die traditionelle
Kluft eines Seemanns!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Schnieke,
was?
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}So weiß man gleich, woran man ist,
wenn man mich am Strand liegend
findet.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Was für ein Gesicht die Leute wohl
machen würden, wenn plötzlich ein
Cowboy am Strand läge?
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Ooh,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} das bringt mich auf eine Idee{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Üstümdeki kıyafet denizciliğin
ta kendisi!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Üstelik beni
inanılmaz çekici gösteriyor{{TAG:0003:002C:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}.
Cazibe{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} etkin{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}! Başka bir
kıyafetle{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} sahilde yatıyor olsam
çok saçma görünürdü. Kovboy{{TAG:0003:000B:}}
kılığında bulsan yüzünü
düşünsene! Hımm... aslında{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0016:}} hiç{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
fena fikir değil.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}This town{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}is definitely one of the
smallest ports I've ever been to.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}With all the seas I've traveled
and towns I've been to,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} this one
feels like a tiny hamster cage!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}I'm not saying {{TAG:0003:0001:}}it feels TOO small,
though.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Just,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} you know,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} I've seen
bigger.
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Hoo, now Isle Delfino!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} THAT was
a nice beach to wash up on{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Este pueblo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} tiene uno de
los puertos más pequeños
que he visto.
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}¡Comparado con todos los puertos
y ciudades que he visitado, este
parece una caja de cerillas!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}No pretendo criticar ni nada de
eso,{{TAG:0003:0001:}} solo digo que los he visto
más impresionantes.
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Aaah, Isla Delfino, ese sí que era
un buen sitio donde despertarse
inconsciente en la playa{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Cette ville{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ce doit être l'un des
plus petits ports dans lesquels j'ai
fait escale.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Pour moi qui ai sillonné tant
d'océans,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} cette ville est comme
une cage à hamster !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}C'est pas pour critiquer, hein. {{TAG:0003:0001:}}
Les petites villes aussi ont leur
charme.
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Mais quand je repense à l'île
Delfino, ÇA c'était des plages où on
s'échouerait tous les jours{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Questa città{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ha uno dei porti
più piccoli che abbia mai visto.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ho attraversato i sette mari, io,
e visitato grandi città.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} In confronto,
questa è davvero microscopica!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ora, non voglio dire che sia {{TAG:0003:0001:}}troppo
piccola per me, eh. Solo che ho
visto città più grandi di questa.
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}L'Isola Delfina... Ah, quella sì che
aveva una spiaggia incantevole{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Diese Stadt{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ist eines der kleinsten
Nester, in die es mich je verschlagen
hat.
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Im Vergleich zum weiten Ozean
fühle ich mich hier wie in einem
Meerschweinchenkäfig!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ich will nicht sagen, dass es hier ZU
eng ist. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Nur...{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} Na ja, ich hab schon
größere Städte gesehen.
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Hach ja...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Isla Delfino, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}DAS war
ein schöner Strand für einen
Schiffbrüchigen{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Just between the two of us,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I've
actually traveled the vastness of
space as well!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}However,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} no one I've ever talked to
believes any of my many harrowing
tales of adventure.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}But let me tell you one thing I
learned when floatin' about out
there.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001F:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Space is DARK!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Entre tú y yo,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} aquí donde me ves,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¡un servidor se ha recorrido
gran parte del espacio!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Sin embargo,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} nadie se cree
ninguna de mis emocionantes
aventuras intergalácticas.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Te daré un consejo por si vas
al espacio alguna vez:{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001F:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0007:000B:}}llévate
una manta, que hace frío.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Ça reste entre nous, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}mais j'ai aussi
voyagé dans l'immensité de
l'espace intersidéral !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Enfin,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} quand je raconte ça, jamais
personne ne veut me croire.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}En tout cas, laisse-moi te dire une
chose.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001F:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Dans l'espace,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} il fait NOIR !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Che rimanga tra noi,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ma
devi sapere che ho esplorato
anche le profondità dello spazio!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Eppure,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} tutte le persone
a cui l'ho detto non
mi hanno mai creduto!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Comunque, lascia che ti dica una
cosa che ho imparato viaggiando
tra le stelle:{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001F:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}lo spazio è buio!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Weil du es bist, verrate ich dir ein
Geheimnis...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich habe auch schon
das Weltall bereist!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Leider glaubt mir nie jemand, wenn
ich von meinen Abenteuern dort
berichte.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Das Wichtigste, was ich dort gelernt
habe?{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001F:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Wenn du in den Weltraum
gehst, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}nimm eine Taschenlampe mit.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}I never thought a seagull like me
would be such dead weight once
I hit the water.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}When I was a chick,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I went to swim
classes every week,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} though I did
have water wings as a backup{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Debería haberme tomado más
en serio las clases de natación
cuando era un polluelo.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Puedo navegar con un ala atada
a la espalda,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} pero nadar sin mi
flotador,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ya es otro cantar...
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}J'aurais jamais cru être aussi
mauvais nageur... Quelle honte
pour une mouette !
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Pourtant, quand j'étais oisillon,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
j'ai pris des cours de natation,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} mais
j'avais des brassards...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Non pensavo che un gabbiano come
me se la sarebbe cavata così male
una volta in acqua...
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Quando ero un pulcino,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} andavo
a lezione di nuoto tutti giorni,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
ma mettevo sempre i braccioli...
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Als ich ins Wasser fiel, musste ich
feststellen, dass ich das Schwimmen
verlernt habe.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Als Küken hatte ich
noch Schwimmflügel...
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Benim gibi bir martının suya
düşünce bu kadar ağırlaşacağını
hiç düşünmezdim{{TAG:0003:001B:}}. Civcivken her{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
hafta yüzme dersine giderdim
gerçi{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}... Ama yedek olarak kolluk
da takardım{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Me gustaría quedarme y compartir
más historias contigo, de verdad,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
pero debo seguir mi camino.
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Me quedan muchos puertos que
visitar, así que no creo que vuelva
por aquí.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aun así, ha sido un placer conocerte
y por eso me voy a despedir con
un{{TAG:0003:0020:}} "¡hasta la vista!".
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Je suis vraiment heureux d'avoir pu
faire ta connaissance !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} J'espère
qu'on se reverra un jour !
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Enfin, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}je suis un homme de la mer{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Il est peu probable que mes périples
me mènent à nouveau ici !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Bonne continuation !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Sono felice di averti conosciuto.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Spero che avremo ancora occasione
di raccontarci qualche storia.
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Ma sai, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}io sono un uomo di mare{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
